LESSON: THE HOLY

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The 5.1 Prayer By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to read Matt
Topic 5.2: The Holy

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Holy. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the promise Jesus gave to 45 5 lessons faith in God
2. appreciate the work of the Holy Holy Spirit on flash cards and read them aloud in pairs work of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. state the promise Jesus gave to 45 5 lessons faith in God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to state the promise Jesus gave to 45 5 lessons faith in God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the work of the Holy Holy Spirit on flash cards and read them aloud in pairs work of the Holy Spirit
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the work of the Holy Holy Spirit on flash cards and read them aloud in pairs work of the Holy Spirit. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Holy.
2. Explain The Holy to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should mention examples of promises they 1. What did Jesus Spirit learner should be able to: have been given by their parents promise His a) state the promise Jesus gave to
4. Show that you can: state the promise Jesus gave to 45 5 lessons faith in God
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Holy. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is The Holy important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Mention examples of promises they 1. What did Jesus Spirit learner should be able to: have been given by their parents promise His a) state the promise Jesus gave to
2. Read Acts 1: 4 and Acts 2:3-4 disciples? 45 5 lessons His disciples and desire to have
3. Be guided to write the work of the Holy Spirit on flash cards and read them aloud in pairs

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. state the promise Jesus gave to 45 5 lessons faith in God
2. appreciate the work of the Holy Holy Spirit on flash cards and read them aloud in pairs work of the Holy Spirit

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
